title: Dexcom can now write BG to HealthConnect, potential to use that for data?
body: I saw the enhancement request here: https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/issues/3954 but seeing as that was dealing with writing to healthconnect, I figure this should have its own request. Since dexcom can write to healthconnect at the same speed as writing to clarity, this could remove the need for a patched app or a middleman to use the G7, allowing people to use the stock app. Seeing as Diakem and BYODA are currently broken for many people, this would be very helpful.

comments.body: Upon looking into this, it appears to be on a 3 hour delay. I might just be using it wrong
